name: Ren'ai 0 Kilometer
source:
A reckless mother with 5 daughters lived next door to a reckless father with 4 sons. The daughters wished for a boy in the family, while the sons wanted a girl. So their parents proposed that they swap one child between the two families for 3 months. Kyouichi, the second-oldest son, was selected and the girls, who were only osananajimis before, now treated him like their own otouto or onii-chan. The girl who was swapped out also had feelings for him and was extremely jealous that she cannot be part of the family as well. He felt both happy and very uneasy... how will this pretend-family turn out?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一名莽撞的母亲带着五个女儿住在隔壁，另一名莽撞的父亲带着四个儿子。女儿们希望家里有男孩，儿子们则想有女孩，于是父母提议两家交换一个孩子三个月。次子矢崎京一被选中。原本只是青梅竹马的女孩们，如今把他当成亲弟弟或哥哥。被交换出去的女孩也喜欢他，无法成为家庭一员令她极其嫉妒。他既高兴又不安……这个伪装家庭会走向何方？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
